categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three main business segments: urban water environment comprehensive management, industrial wastewater treatment comprehensive services, and small town environmental comprehensive services. It provides integrated solutions including investment, construction, operation, and maintenance of municipal sewage treatment plants, industrial wastewater treatment, rural sewage treatment, and watershed management. The company also engages in EPC (engineering, procurement, and construction) projects and water treatment equipment manufacturing and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced water treatment technologies such as AAO, SBR, oxidation ditch processes, and zero discharge technologies for industrial wastewater. It emphasizes technology and operation integration, with proprietary innovations in smart water management platforms using IoT, AI, and digital twin technologies. The company also develops specialized equipment like high-efficiency flotation devices, biological reactors, and ozone oxidation reactors, and focuses on low-carbon and energy-efficient water treatment processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include municipal governments, industrial parks, and enterprises in sectors such as petrochemical, coal chemical, steel, pharmaceuticals, food and beverage, automotive manufacturing, and textiles. The company serves domestic markets across over 20 provinces and cities in China and has expanded into overseas markets including Ethiopia. Major clients include local government water management offices and construction companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with significant presence in Anhui, East China, South China, Central and Southwest China, Northwest, North China, and Northeast China regions. It also has overseas operations, notably in Ethiopia and Norway. The company has over 100 sewage treatment plants nationwide and multiple subsidiaries in various provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the water treatment supply chain, including project investment, engineering construction (EPC), equipment manufacturing, and operation and maintenance of water treatment facilities. It acts as both a service provider and equipment supplier, integrating upstream technology development with downstream operational services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing smart water management through digitalization and AI, enhancing low-carbon and energy-efficient water treatment technologies, and expanding integrated watershed and industrial park water solutions. R&D focuses on developing new treatment processes, smart operation platforms, and specialized equipment, with collaborations involving top universities and research institutes. The company also emphasizes innovation in industrial wastewater zero discharge and rural water environment governance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through multiple streams: operation and maintenance service fees from water treatment plants, EPC contract revenues for engineering projects, sales of water treatment equipment, and consulting/design services. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns on PPP and BOT projects. The revenue mix is dominated by operation services, followed by engineering construction and equipment sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's water environment management sector, recognized as one of the earliest market-oriented municipal water service providers. It holds a strong market position with extensive operational scale and brand influence, frequently ranked among top environmental enterprises in China. Competitors include large state-owned enterprises and other specialized environmental service providers, with increasing competition from central and local government-backed firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 3.84 billion RMB, a slight decline of 7.04% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders at about 367 million RMB, down 6.54%. Despite revenue pressure from engineering services, operation services and equipment sales showed growth. The company maintains a solid asset base of over 16.45 billion RMB and continues to invest in R&D and infrastructure, with positive cash flow growth and stable profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive water treatment industry chain capabilities, integrating technology innovation with operational excellence. It differentiates through advanced proprietary technologies, smart digital operation platforms, and customized solutions for municipal, industrial, and rural water environments. Its strong R&D partnerships and extensive project experience enable it to deliver high-quality, efficient, and sustainable water treatment services, supporting national environmental strategies and regional ecological governance.
